content.text: The digital product economy is structurally unfair to creators in restricted markets. The tools that Western creators take for granted — Stripe for payments, Gumroad for storefront and delivery, PayPal for international transfers — are either unavailable or functionally broken for creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Zimbabwe, and dozens of other markets. The answer is not finding a better platform. The answer is removing the platform layer entirely. A sovereign digital commerce stack gives you a storefront you host, a payment processor that runs on blockchain rails, and an automated delivery system that sends your product within 30 seconds of payment confirmation. You collect revenue directly into a wallet you control. You convert to local currency through P2P exchanges at near-market rates. The platform cannot suspend you because you are not on any platform.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/understanding-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-plain-language-13. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Design assets

The automated delivery pipeline for digital products follows a specific sequence that eliminates every manual step. A buyer visits the storefront, selects a product, and initiates payment. The checkout displays a QR code with the exact wallet address and payment amount in their chosen cryptocurrency, converted from USD at the current exchange rate via live price feeds. The buyer sends the payment from their wallet. NOWPayments monitors the blockchain and detects the incoming transaction within seconds of broadcast. When the transaction receives sufficient confirmations on-chain, NOWPayments fires a webhook to your [[LINK:https://[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/coremerch-sovereign-stack-deployment-guide-honest-side-side-16|The COREMERCH]].github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-webhook-driven-crypto-payment-fulfillment-explained-digital-16|cloudflare]] Worker or Google Apps Script endpoint. The backend verifies the payment amount, confirms the transaction hash on the blockchain directly, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the download link to the buyer's email address.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-selling-ebooks-without-paypal-stripe-7|COREMERCH guide to architecture]] behind COREMERCH's solution involves a combination of free and paid tools, including GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. This infrastructure enables automatic crypto payment processing and instant product delivery, all while ensuring the creator retains full data ownership. With NOWPayments, creators can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with a minimal fee of 0.5%, significantly lower than the 10% charged by platforms like Gumroad.
Who This Is Built For and Why

COREMERCH is designed specifically for digital creators who face restrictions in using traditional payment platforms. This includes sellers of ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, and other digital products. By providing a sovereign commerce infrastructure, COREMERCH empowers these creators to sell their products globally, without the need for PayPal, Stripe, or other restricted platforms. The focus is on giving creators the freedom to own their sales process and reach customers directly, regardless of geographical or platform restrictions.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure gives creators full control over their sales process.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components of COREMERCH's solution include the use of GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, which provides a reliable and scalable infrastructure for digital stores. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle the backend logic, enabling automated processes such as order fulfillment and payment verification. Supabase or Google Sheets store order information, ensuring that creators have access to their sales data at all times. NOWPayments integrates seamlessly into this setup, offering a wide range of cryptocurrency payment options with minimal fees.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start selling digital products with crypto payments, creators can begin by setting up their store using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. They then integrate Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, followed by setting up Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. Finally, they integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. With these components in place, creators can load their digital products and start selling immediately, benefiting from the low fees and high flexibility of the COREMERCH infrastructure.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, creators can leverage the COREMERCH infrastructure, which combines hosting, backend logic, and payment processing into a single, sovereign solution. By using crypto payments, creators can avoid platform fees and reach a broader audience. For instance, with NOWPayments, the fee is only 0.5% compared to Gumroad's 10%, retaining more revenue for the creator.
NOWPayments offers a 0.5% fee, significantly lower than traditional platforms.

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack, start by setting up your hosting with GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, integrate Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and set up Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. Then, integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. Load your digital products into the system, configure your store's frontend, and test the entire workflow to ensure seamless order fulfillment and payment processing.
